data.heading: Make Election Day a fiber day
data.body:
Fiber Uppercut is a once-a-day powder that mixes into water, smoothies or coffee in seconds. Citrus-peach flavor, no grit, no gluten.

Mix one scoop with 8 oz of liquid. Stir, sip, done.

Our Election Day special is on. Try it for $10.
